aiDescription.summary: The bill amends 38 U.S.C. 8127(h) to remove paragraph (3), renumber paragraph (4) as paragraph (3), and insert the phrase "established under the Small Business Act (15 U.S.C. 631 et seq.)" into the redesignated paragraph. The change applies to the Department of Veterans Affairs' procurement preference hierarchy, clarifying that the referenced small-business preference covers entities established under the Small Business Act for VA contracting.

description.text: Veterans Affairs Opportunity for Small Businesses Act of 2026

impact.summary: The bill amends 38 U.S.C. 8127(h) to require the Department of Veterans Affairs' procurement hierarchy to use small‑business categories "established under the Small Business Act." It would affect VA contracting offices and firms bidding on VA contracts—especially veterans‑owned and service‑disabled veteran‑owned small businesses and other Small Business Administration–defined small business categories—by aligning VA preferences with SBA definitions.

latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.
